caption: Pro: the Area group has one switch for each value of the area property.
eval:
(async () => { await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); const p = app.plugins.plugins['bases-filter-switches']; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('bases-filter-switches-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); await app.vault.process(app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('Bases Filter Switches/Tasks.base'), (t) => t + "    - name: Area
      property: area
  presets:
    - name: Open work
      on: [Status/Todo, Status/Doing, Area/work]
    - name: Finished
      on: [Status/Done]
"); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); [...document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .fsw-bar button')].filter((b) => b.offsetParent).find((b) => b.textContent === "work")?.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); [...document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .fsw-bar button')].filter((b) => b.offsetParent).find((b) => b.textContent === "Todo")?.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); return 'ok'; })()

caption: The free Pause control keeps Todo selected for a later Resume.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['bases-filter-switches']; p.pro.signOut(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); const bar = [...document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .fsw-bar')].find(b => b.offsetParent); [...bar.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent === 'Todo').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 700)); bar.querySelector('.fsw-pause').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 700)); const resume = bar.querySelector('.fsw-pause'); if (resume.textContent !== 'Resume') throw new Error('Pause did not save the selection'); return 'free pause PASS'; })()

caption: A quick filter area: work from the Filter by property button: the chip is in the bar and the base shows the 5 work notes.
eval: (async () => { await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); const bar = [...document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .fsw-bar')].find((b) => b.offsetParent); bar.querySelector('.fsw-quick').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); const [property, match] = [...document.querySelectorAll('.fsw-quick-modal select.dropdown:not(.is-measuring)')]; property.value = 'area'; property.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); match.value = 'is'; match.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); const input = document.querySelector('.fsw-quick-modal input'); input.value = 'work'; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); document.querySelector('.fsw-quick-modal button.mod-cta').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 900)); if (!bar.querySelector('.fsw-quick-chip')) throw new Error('no quick filter chip'); document.querySelectorAll('.suggestion-container').forEach((s) => s.remove()); return 'ok'; })()
after: (async () => { const f = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('Bases Filter Switches/Tasks.base'); if (f) await app.plugins.plugins['bases-filter-switches'].clearQuick(f); return 'ok'; })()
